title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Title Update v1.2.0
summary: Find out the latest EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Update details in the Title Update v1.2.0 Notes.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC 27 version 1.2.0 is now live and includes the updates below.

sections.title: Gameplay
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Adjusted how defenders position themselves with extreme defensive line heights. Defenders will now drop off sooner while still maintaining a higher line than other tactics.

sections.title: Ultimate Team
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Players were not always able to advance through the Evolution preview flow when attempting to re-preview an Evolution chain after backing out of an Evolution preview chain. Updated some player bios.

sections.title: The Grounds
sections.summary: Made the following changes: [PC Only] Added two new Settings: The Grounds Camera Mouse Sensitivity Y and The Grounds Camera Mouse Sensitivity X. Addressed the following issues: The Edit Emote option in the Emote Wheel brought players to the outfit tab of the…

sections.title: Career Mode
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Removed Season Pass level up screen after playing Career Mode matches. Added the Energy Recovery setting for Manager Career.

hits.label: AXP
hits.quote: Updated Clubs Friendlies end of match AXP generation to be in-line with Clubs League Match.

hits.label: Archetypes
hits.quote: After swapping Archetypes, the wrong Archetype level and background could be displayed in match intros. [PC Only] When loading the match intros for a Kickabouts or Street Football match, a loading animation would not be displayed.

hits.label: Amps
hits.quote: Amps details were still displayed for a short time after being unequipped.

hits.label: Rush
hits.quote: In rare cases, Player Avatars could have invisible arms when returning from In-World Rush matches.
